listing.name: Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere (Japan) / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Native recompilation of the Japan two-disc edition of Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere.

steps.title: Prepare the Mac toolchain and setup kit
steps.instruction: Install Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3. Verify that the tools are on PATH, then unpack the official Intel or Apple Silicon ZIP that matches your Mac into a separate writable folder.

steps.title: Supply your original files
steps.instruction: Use your original Japanese edition, Disc 1 SLPS-02020 then Disc 2 SLPS-02021. Keep the two disc images together and preserve their order. Use the kit’s included OpenBIOS or follow its guide for a supported retail BIOS. Follow the kit’s README-SETUP.txt for the image format and BIOS options.

steps.title: Build and add the prepared player
steps.instruction: From the unpacked folder, run Ace_Combat_3__Electrosphere__Japan__Recompiled and follow its Generate & rebuild wizard. In Portcove, select build-release/Ace_Combat_3__Electrosphere__Japan__Recompiled as the program and build-release as the start folder. Keep the external runtime and use upstream instructions for replacement.

warnings: Mac setup uses the upstream kit and your local toolchain. Mac build, gameplay and populated saves remain unobserved.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Preserve the entire working folder with its saves, settings, overlay captures, original disc files and any required BIOS. Keep a copy of the creating runtime before updating the kit.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own matching single-track CHDs in Disc 1 SLPS-02020 then Disc 2 SLPS-02021 order and legally obtained retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. This route uses Portcove’s registered Python/build toolchain and skips the upstream setup launcher when playing. Generation, runtime, disc switching, lifecycle, minimum-host compatibility and gameplay are untested on both declared platforms. Preserve GPL-3.0-only project, PolyForm Noncommercial framework and MIT UI notices; no rights to retail game data or generated retail content are inferred.
